title: The Greedy Frog Who Wanted All The Flies: Being Satisfied!

lines.text: Barnaby the bullfrog sat on his giant lily pad, rubbing his plump green tummy!
lines.caps: Barnaby the frog sat on his *LILY PAD, | rubbing his plump green *TUMMY!

lines.text: He had already eaten twenty crunchy flies, but his eyes were bigger than his stomach!
lines.caps: He ate twenty crunchy *FLIES, | but his eyes were bigger than his *STOMACH!

lines.text: A golden swarm buzzed overhead, and Barnaby snapped: I want every single one!
lines.caps: A golden swarm buzzed *OVERHEAD, | and Barnaby snapped: I want *EVERY ONE!

lines.text: SLURP! He stuffed thirty more flies into his mouth until his cheeks bulged!
lines.caps: *SLURP! He stuffed thirty more *FLIES | until his green cheeks *BULGED!

lines.text: Groan! His tummy was so swollen and heavy, his lily pad began to sink under water!
lines.caps: *GROAN! His tummy was so heavy, | his lily pad began to *SINK | *UNDER!

lines.text: He couldn't leap, he couldn't sing, and he had a giant bellyache all afternoon!
lines.caps: He couldn't *LEAP, | he couldn't sing, with a giant *BELLYACHE | all day *LONG!

lines.text: Little Dragonfly fluttered by: Enough is a feast, Barnaby. Greed only sinks your pad!
lines.caps: Dragonfly buzzed by: *ENOUGH | is a feast! Greed only sinks your *PAD!

lines.text: Knowing when to stop and enjoying what you have brings genuine peace!
lines.caps: Knowing when to *STOP | and enjoying what you have brings real *PEACE!
